stem.text: Compound X has the following properties.

items: When 0.20 mol of X undergoes complete combustion, 14.4 dm$^{3}$ of carbon dioxide is produced, measured under room conditions.
X reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine reagent to give an orange crystalline product.
X does **not** give a yellow precipitate with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$.
